fields.font_size_hint: Adjust text and icon size for different screen resolutions
fields.send_key_hint: Key combination to submit a message
fields.busy_input_mode_hint: Controls what happens when you send a message while the agent is running
fields.session_poll_interval_hint: How often to check for externally added messages (seconds, 0=off)
fields.approval_timeout_hint: Auto-deny after N seconds. Backend default: 60s. Keep this ≤ backend timeout.
fields.clarify_timeout_hint: Auto-pick first choice after N seconds. Backend default: 600s. Keep this ≤ backend timeout.
fields.default_reasoning_effort_hint: Set the global default reasoning effort for new sessions (config.yaml)
fields.show_cli_sessions_hint: Include command-line sessions in the sidebar
fields.show_messaging_sessions_hint: Include messaging platform sessions (WeChat, Telegram, Discord, ...) in the sidebar
fields.show_cron_sessions_hint: Include cron job sessions in the sidebar
fields.auto_compress_threshold_hint: Automatically compress session history when message count exceeds this limit. Uses AI to summarize older exchanges, freeing up context window space.
fields.auto_compress_msg_threshold_hint: Path 1 — Trigger compression when the session reaches this many messages. Compresses in-place in the same session.
fields.auto_compress_token_threshold_hint: Trigger compression when prompt tokens reach this percentage of the model's context window. Like the message-count path, compresses in-place in the same session.
fields.auto_compress_poor_ratio_hint: A compression counts as "poor" when the retained message ratio exceeds this value. Consecutive poor compressions disable auto-compress until history is cleared or a compression is effective.
fields.auto_compress_disable_after_hint: Disable auto-compress for the session after this many consecutive poor compressions.
fields.max_compaction_snapshots_hint: Maximum number of read-only archived snapshots to keep per session. Older snapshots beyond this limit are automatically deleted.
